editorNote: A risk-off day across the watchlist: bitcoin at a two-year low, gold sliding again, Rocket Lab's losing streak lengthening, and the Nasdaq's 2026 gains gone. Several items rest on headlines only, since article pages could not be retrieved. Facts only, no calls.

stories.headline: Bitcoin falls to its lowest in two years, with CoinDesk putting it below $57,000 and $2.4 billion in crypto bets wiped out
stories.summary: Reuters and Bloomberg headlines say bitcoin hit a two-year low as global markets sank. CoinDesk's headline says it tanked below $57,000, wiping out $2.4 billion in crypto bets; Forbes' headline describes panic ahead of the weekend.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin has now broken below the roughly $62,000 three-month low reported on Nov. 15, with leveraged positions liquidated in the move.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin falls to its lowest in two years - Reuters
Bitcoin (BTC) tanks below $57,000, wiping out $2.4 billion in crypto bets - CoinDesk
Bitcoin Falls to More Than Two-Year Low as Global Markets Sink - Bloomberg.com

stories.headline: An intensifying AI rout wipes out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, with CNBC calling Alphabet a tech bright spot
stories.summary: CNBC's headline says the AI-driven sell-off erased the Nasdaq's gains for the year, while Alphabet was an exception among large tech names.
stories.whyItMatters: The year-to-date gain in the tech-heavy index is gone, the backdrop for several of today's holdings moves.

sourceLinks.title: Intensifying AI rout wipes out Nasdaq's 2026 gains. Alphabet is a tech bright spot - CNBC

stories.headline: Gold falls 2.33% on Nov. 20, and BullionVault says its slump is the longest since 1970
stories.summary: USA Today's daily price report has gold down 2.33% on Nov. 20. BullionVault's 'Everything Crash' piece says the price decline has extended to the longest slump since 1970.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold's retreat from earlier in the month, when it sat near a 14-month low, deepened on the day.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Price Today: Gold Falls 2.33% on November 20, 2026 - USA Today
'Everything Crash' Sees Gold Price Extend Longest Slump Since 1970 - BullionVault

stories.headline: Rocket Lab has now fallen seven straight sessions, down 31%, and Seeking Alpha has it sliding 11% in a broad pullback
stories.summary: Trefis counts seven straight red days and a 31% decline for Rocket Lab (RKLB). Seeking Alpha's headline says the stock slid 11% amid a broad market pullback, and Startup Fortune reports a 10.8% fall to $45.44 as the Neutron delay met a tech rout.
stories.whyItMatters: The losing streak lengthened from the six sessions and roughly 23% decline reported yesterday.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Stock: 7 Straight Red Days, Down 31% - Trefis

stories.headline: Broadcom falls on a report that Google is cutting AI chip shipments, Barron's says
stories.summary: Barron's headline says Broadcom stock fell on a report that Google is cutting AI chip shipments. The article text could not be retrieved, so details of the report are not available here.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline links a report about Alphabet's chip orders to a move in its supplier's shares.

sourceLinks.title: Broadcom Stock Falls on Report Google is Cutting AI Chip Shipments - Barron's

stories.headline: Alibaba's targets are cut by Citigroup, Barclays and Baird after its warning of slower cloud growth, TradingView says
stories.summary: TradingView's 'Key facts' headline says Alibaba warned of slower cloud growth and that Citigroup, Barclays and Baird cut price targets. A Seeking Alpha headline cites 50%-plus cloud growth and a 9.1x P/E.
stories.whyItMatters: Analysts adjusted forecasts after the Nov. 19 results, in which adjusted EPS missed.

sourceLinks.title: Key facts: Alibaba Warns of Slower Cloud Growth; Citigroup, Barclays and Baird Cut Targets - TradingView
Alibaba: 50%+ Cloud Growth, 9.1x P/E, Oversold (NYSE:BABA) - Seeking Alpha

stories.headline: Law firms say a securities class action has been filed against Alibaba after export-control issues and a 7% stock drop
stories.summary: Law-firm notices carried by The Daily Tribune News and The National Law Review say a securities class action has been filed against Alibaba Group, tying it to export-control issues that led to a 7% stock drop.
stories.whyItMatters: These are law-firm announcements of allegations, not court findings.
